_what_is: A/B/C test of the offer paragraph. In each email ONLY this part changes: the first line, the sector paragraph and the signature are the same. Each offer has up to three variants (A, B, C); each variant has one entry per locale: [paragraph, closing question]. A variant is assigned once per company and balanced inside each sector (score/draft), then stored in the email, the queue and the contacts file. A single variant (just 'A') means no test.

es: Para que conozcan el trabajo antes de decidir, les traduzco gratis las 2 primeras páginas de un documento real, una vez por empresa, con una cotización formal válida por 30 días. El material más largo se cotiza por palabra, desde 9 centavos por palabra.
¿Les sirve enviarme primero el documento que más necesitan en español?
en: To see the work before deciding, I translate the first 2 pages of one real document at no cost, once per company, with a formal quote valid for 30 days. Larger material is quoted per word, from 9 cents a word.
Would it help if you sent me the document you'd want in Spanish first?
